## Featured updates

[Image of a person flushing their dental unit waterlines using the A-dec Flush Dock over a sink]

#### How to Clean and Maintain Dental Unit Waterlines

Learn a clear, step-by-step approach to dental unit waterline (DUWL) maintenance—from choosing the
right water source to monitoring, shocking, and flushing treatments.

[Read article][128]
[A dental office employee looking at the Link AI inbox]

#### AI Dental Receptionist: Turn Missed Calls Into Revenue

Learn how AI dental receptionist software helps streamline scheduling, communication, and front desk
workflows.

[Read article][129]
[A-dec Impact logo]

#### A-dec Donates $1 Million to Dental Trade Alliance Foundation

A‑dec announced a transformative $1,000,000 endowment, in partnership with The Dental Trade Alliance
Foundation.

[Read press release][130]
[A-dec and Dentsply Sirona collaboration logos]

#### A-dec and Dentsply Sirona Expand Partnership

A‑dec and Dentsply Sirona expand their strategic partnership by integrating the Midwest Motor System
into A‑dec Pro delivery systems.

[Read press release][131]
[Two curved dark blue arrows containing the words A-dec Buyback Program]

#### A‑dec Buyback Program

Get cash back for your used A‑dec dental equipment.

[Learn more][132]
[Townie awards for A-dec dental equipment]

#### Thank you, Townie dentists

Since 2003, Dentaltown magazine's online community of dental professionals has consistently named
A‑dec products as the best across multiple categories.

[About the awards][133]
[3D visualization of A-dec dental equipment coming out of a phone]

#### 5 Tips and Tricks for Dream in 3D

From starting with a blank room or uploading photos of an existing space, to using AI-generated
color palettes, AR/VR visualization, and easy sharing tools, see how doctors can plan their
operatories with confidence.

[Read article][134]

## A-dec+ connected dentistry

Simple. Reliable. Intuitive. Imagine an updatable software platform that keeps your dental practice
ready for whatever lies ahead.

[Explore A-dec+][135]
[A-dec+ web and mobile application]

## Featured resources

Dream in 3D

Explore A‑dec dental equipment in 3D, and see products in your space with AR. Customize colors and
materials, and order free color samples.

[Explore Dream in 3D][136]

Order color samples

Order free A‑dec upholstery and cabinet color samples.

[Find your perfect color][137]

A‑dec buyback program

Get cash back for your A‑dec dental equipment—and get our best deal when you purchase new A‑dec
equipment at the same time.

[A-dec buyback program][138]

Customer stories

Hear why doctors choose A‑dec dental equipment to design healthy, comfortable, and high-quality
dental office experiences.

[Watch videos][139]

All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. ## At Orascoptic, we know visualization.

#### And you've recognized us with awards.   

Masters of our craft, we unlock your most important clinical instrument to help empower you in your
day-to-day.

We custom design our products to be an extension of you, helping you perform better and practice
safer. 

Together we enable you to see the unseen, to practice more ergonomically and excel at your craft.

#### We're honored to be the recipients of 21 Townie Choice Awards for Best Loupes and 9 Cellerant
#### Best of Class Technology Awards.

## **Medical**

Surgical procedures demand extraordinary precision and judgement. Orascoptic surgical loupes enable
surgeons to operate with exceptional visual clarity.

[ More Info ][67]

## **Dental**

From composite fillings to endodontic treatments, our custom-made dental loupes enable you to
increase your productivity, improve your performance and practice more ergonomically. 

[ More Info ][68]

## **Hygienists**

Empowering you to perform at your best and promote a long and healthy career. Our RDH line of
solutions is designed with hygienists for hygienists.

[ More Info ][69]

## **Students**

We are here for you as you embark on your biggest adventure yet. Custom loupes and headlights are an
extension of you as you carve your way into the healthcare industry.

[ More Info ][70]

## Don't take our word for it.

Hear straight from your peers on how Orascoptic has impacted their practice.

*"Since using Orascoptic loupes I have better posture, and the pain in my neck has gone away. I
would definitely recommend these loupes to any hygienest."*

Jessica Parks, RDH

*"I'm currently using the EyeZoom™. It has three different magnifications: 3x,4x,5x. I usually use
the 4x and, if I want to get really close up I'll go to the 5x. If I want more of an overview, I'll
go to the 3x magnification. It's very versatile.”*

Jim Tauschek, DDS
[ Hear from Your Peers ][71]

## **Loupes**

Exceptional magnification is essential for routine exams to intricate surgical procedures. Find your
magnification to enable your best work.

[ Learn More ][72]
[Dental Loupe with Light]

## **Headlights **

You can’t see what you can’t see. Find the lighting solution to improve your visibility by reducing
shadowing in your field of view.

[ Learn More ][73]

## **Safety**

From splatter to radiation protection, browse our safety solution products that help keep you safe.

[ Learn More ][74]

## At Orascoptic, we know visualization.

#### And you've recognized us with awards.   

Masters of our craft, we unlock your most important clinical instrument to help empower you in your
day-to-day.

We custom design our products to be an extension of you, helping you perform better and practice
safer. 

Together we enable you to see the unseen, to practice more ergonomically and excel at your craft.

#### We're honored to be the recipients of 21 Townie Choice Awards for Best Loupes and 9 Cellerant
#### Best of Class Technology Awards.

## **Medical**

Surgical procedures demand extraordinary precision and judgement. Orascoptic surgical loupes enable
surgeons to operate with exceptional visual clarity.

[ More Info ][67]

## **Dental**

From composite fillings to endodontic treatments, our custom-made dental loupes enable you to
increase your productivity, improve your performance and practice more ergonomically. 

[ More Info ][68]

## **Hygienists**

Empowering you to perform at your best and promote a long and healthy career. Our RDH line of
solutions is designed with hygienists for hygienists.

[ More Info ][69]

## **Students**

We are here for you as you embark on your biggest adventure yet. Custom loupes and headlights are an
extension of you as you carve your way into the healthcare industry.

[ More Info ][70]

## Don't take our word for it.

Hear straight from your peers on how Orascoptic has impacted their practice.

*"Since using Orascoptic loupes I have better posture, and the pain in my neck has gone away. I
would definitely recommend these loupes to any hygienest."*

Jessica Parks, RDH

*"I'm currently using the EyeZoom™. It has three different magnifications: 3x,4x,5x. I usually use
the 4x and, if I want to get really close up I'll go to the 5x. If I want more of an overview, I'll
go to the 3x magnification. It's very versatile.”*

Jim Tauschek, DDS
[ Hear from Your Peers ][71]

## **Loupes**

Exceptional magnification is essential for routine exams to intricate surgical procedures. Find your
magnification to enable your best work.

[ Learn More ][72]
[Dental Loupe with Light]

## **Headlights **

You can’t see what you can’t see. Find the lighting solution to improve your visibility by reducing
shadowing in your field of view.

[ Learn More ][73]

## **Safety**

From splatter to radiation protection, browse our safety solution products that help keep you safe.

[ Learn More ][74]

## [About Planmeca Group][330]

Planmeca Oy is the parent company of Planmeca Group, which operates in the field of healthcare
technology and consists of several companies. Planmeca Group companies manufacture and supply
state-of-the-art dental care equipment and instruments, dental and medical imaging devices and
software, as well as mammography systems. Planmeca Group also includes companies providing dental
supplies, services and education.

# 80 Million Patients Protected

For over 25 years, clinicians have trusted Zyris® to help them provide better dentistry, in less
time.

### A Modern Approach to Efficient Dentistry

The Isolite® System is your all-in-one solution for efficient dentistry. From visibility to moisture
control and patient compliance, every feature is designed to help you do better dentistry, in less
time. Practices using Isolite are reducing procedure time by up to 48%.



[Learn More About the Isolite System][133]

Nothing reduces humidity like the Isolite system. Rubber dams and cotton rolls are great, but there
is nothing that gives us total control over the oral environment in so many applications as Isolite.
We couldn’t practice without it.
Drs. Michael Melkers and Jeanine McDonald

### A Modern Approach to Efficient Dentistry

The Isolite® System is your all-in-one solution for efficient dentistry. From visibility to moisture

[Learn More About the Isolite System][133]

Nothing reduces humidity like the Isolite system. Rubber dams and cotton rolls are great, but there
is nothing that gives us total control over the oral environment in so many applications as Isolite.
We couldn’t practice without it.
Drs. Michael Melkers and Jeanine McDonald

### Seeing is Believing! Get an Online Demo of the Isolite.

Ready to see how the Isolite system can help your dental practice?


[Click Here To Get Started][134]

### Gain more control of the oral environment with our dual-quadrant and bicuspid-to-bicuspid
### mouthpieces.

Engineered for optimal patient comfort and clinical efficiency, Isolite's patented single-use
mouthpieces are designed to follow the natural contours of the oral cavity. Available in multiple
sizes to accommodate patients of all ages, these precision-crafted mouthpieces ensure reliable
isolation for both posterior and anterior procedures.

[Learn More About Zyris Mouthpieces][135]

### Introducing....HOOPLA™

The NEW biodegradable HOOPLA™ Retractor maximizes oral cavity access and visibility by comfortably
retracting a patient’s lips and cheeks during restorative, hygiene, cosmetic, and orthodontic
procedures.

Compatible with Zyris Isolite Posterior Mouthpieces and suction devices or for use on any dental
procedure.

So simple and comfortable to use, your patient could insert it themselves in seconds!

[See what all the HOOPLA is about][136]

For over 25 years, clinicians have trusted Zyris® to help them provide better dentistry, in less
time.

### A Modern Approach to Efficient Dentistry

The Isolite® System is your all-in-one solution for efficient dentistry. From visibility to moisture
control and patient compliance, every feature is designed to help you do better dentistry, in less
time. Practices using Isolite are reducing procedure time by up to 48%.



[Learn More About the Isolite System][133]

Nothing reduces humidity like the Isolite system. Rubber dams and cotton rolls are great, but there
is nothing that gives us total control over the oral environment in so many applications as Isolite.
We couldn’t practice without it.
Drs. Michael Melkers and Jeanine McDonald

time.

### A Modern Approach to Efficient Dentistry

The Isolite® System is your all-in-one solution for efficient dentistry. From visibility to moisture
control and patient compliance, every feature is designed to help you do better dentistry, in less
time. Practices using Isolite are reducing procedure time by up to 48%.



[Learn More About the Isolite System][133]

Nothing reduces humidity like the Isolite system. Rubber dams and cotton rolls are great, but there
is nothing that gives us total control over the oral environment in so many applications as Isolite.
We couldn’t practice without it.
Drs. Michael Melkers and Jeanine McDonald

### Seeing is Believing! Get an Online Demo of the Isolite.

Ready to see how the Isolite system can help your dental practice?


[Click Here To Get Started][134]

### Gain more control of the oral environment with our dual-quadrant and bicuspid-to-bicuspid
### mouthpieces.

Engineered for optimal patient comfort and clinical efficiency, Isolite's patented single-use
mouthpieces are designed to follow the natural contours of the oral cavity. Available in multiple
sizes to accommodate patients of all ages, these precision-crafted mouthpieces ensure reliable
isolation for both posterior and anterior procedures.

[Learn More About Zyris Mouthpieces][135]

### Introducing....HOOPLA™

The NEW biodegradable HOOPLA™ Retractor maximizes oral cavity access and visibility by comfortably
retracting a patient’s lips and cheeks during restorative, hygiene, cosmetic, and orthodontic
procedures.

Compatible with Zyris Isolite Posterior Mouthpieces and suction devices or for use on any dental
procedure.

So simple and comfortable to use, your patient could insert it themselves in seconds!

## Thank you for visiting Australian Dental Clinic

**Australian Dental Clinic** was established in 2006, located right center of **Hanoi** with five
minutes walk from Sword Lake. Proudly we are the first local dental clinic taking care of
expatriates and foreign tourists in **Hanoi.**

Expanding its footprint, the clinic recently inaugurated a new branch in **Da Nang**, extending its
exceptional services to residents and visitors alike. This expansion underscores the clinic's
dedication to delivering high-quality dental solutions across **Vietnam**.

Our philosophy is simple. We try to provide quality dental care for you and your family in a happy,
professional, and caring environment.

Our aim is to care for you as a person and give you a healthy, beautiful smile in comfortable
surroundings. We endeavor to dispel the myth that a visit to the dentist should be an uncomfortable
experience. In striving for this, we have developed a warm, welcoming facility, incorporating the
latest advancements in dental technology, and most importantly…established a team of highly skilled,
motivated, and caring professionals to provide you with the best dental care. It is important to us
that you feel welcomed and comfortable during each visit and that you go with a smile…

Our Dentists have extensive experience in providing quality treatments, including: Whitening,
Veneers, Crowns & Bridges, White Fillings, Root Canal, Implant, Straighter Teeth, Orthodontics,
Braces, and Cosmetic Dentistry.

# Dental Air Polishers for Modern Dental Clinics

Last reviewed: June 3, 2026 · By DentalAirPolisher Editorial Team

Compare professional dental air polishing systems across the full player-tier brand set (Acteon,
Dentsply Sirona, EMS, Hu-Friedy, NSK, W&H, Woodpecker — plus adjacent-tier Mectron), understand
pricing, and request information from authorised distributors — all in one independent place.

[Compare systems][7] [Compare air polishing systems][8]
[Dental hygienist using an air polisher in modern clinic] Air polishing has become a routine step in
modern dental prophylaxis appointments. Photo: Unsplash The basics

## What is a dental air polisher?

A dental air polisher is a professional device used in dental prophylaxis and biofilm management. It
delivers a controlled mixture of compressed air, water and a fine cleaning powder onto the tooth
surface. The combined jet removes biofilm, soft deposits and extrinsic stains — including those in
pits, fissures, interproximal areas and around orthodontic appliances or implants.

Air polishing has become a routine part of modern hygiene visits and structured prophylaxis
protocols. Depending on the system and the powder used (sodium bicarbonate, glycine, erythritol,
calcium carbonate and others), it can be used *supragingivally* for stain removal or *subgingivally*
for periodontal and peri-implant maintenance.

Most systems on the market are used by dentists, dental hygienists and prophylaxis assistants in
private practice, multi-chair clinics and dental service organizations.

[Read our full dental air polisher buying guide →][9]

The market

## Player-tier brands (alphabetical)

The seven brands compared by dental clinics today, listed alphabetically without favouritism. Each
has different strengths in workflow, ergonomics, powder compatibility and total cost of ownership.

A

### Acteon Air-N-Go

A long-established air polishing line with multiple powder options for supra and subgingival use.

[Learn more →][10]
D

### Dentsply Sirona Cavitron Prophy Jet

Combined ultrasonic scaler and air polishing system with a long US-anchored installed base. USA

[Learn more →][11]
E

### EMS AIRFLOW Prophylaxis Master

Premium combined tabletop with AIRFLOW, PERIOFLOW and PIEZON. Predecessor to the GBT Machine.
€6,400–€8,000 ex-VAT

[Learn more →][12]
E

### EMS GBT Machine

Current EMS flagship, launched at IDS 2025. Automatic handpiece recognition, EMS Partner 2.0
dashboard. ~€9,166 ex-VAT

[Learn more →][13]
H

### Hu-Friedy PWR Air + PWR Pair

North American mid-premium standalone (PWR Air) and combined ultrasonic + air polisher (PWR Pair).
~€1,800–€2,200 ex-VAT

[Learn more →][14]
N

### NSK Prophy-Mate neo + Perio-Mate

Handpiece-style supra and subgingival polishers connecting to existing turbine couplings. Flash
Pearl powder is calcium carbonate (~54 µm), not sodium bicarbonate.

[Learn more →][15]
W

### W&H Proxeo Aura

Tabletop air polisher with the SOFT (erythritol) / SMOOTH (glycine) / SENSITIVE (sodium bicarbonate)
powder line. ~€400–€600 ex-VAT

[Learn more →][16]
W

### Woodpecker air polishers

Cost-competitive air polishers — AP-H standalone and PT-E combined tabletop system — widely
available in international markets. Woodpecker ABC protocol.

[Learn more →][17]
M

### Mectron Combi Touch (adjacent-tier)

Combined piezoelectric scaler and air polisher in a single unit, with a dedicated subgingival
nozzle.

[Learn more →][18]
Decision framework

## Compare before buying

Air polishers vary widely in price, ergonomics and total cost of ownership. Before committing to a
system, clinics typically compare the following dimensions:
* **Price** — Capital cost of the unit, plus financing or leasing options.
* **Clinical indication** — Supragingival only, or supra + subgingival use; suitability for
  periodontal and peri-implant maintenance.
* **Local support** — Distributor coverage, response time and on-site service in your country.
* **Training** — Whether onboarding, GBT certification or hygienist training is included.
* **Consumables** — Cost and availability of compatible powders and replacement parts.
* **Powders available** — Sodium bicarbonate, glycine, erythritol, calcium carbonate — and which are
  validated by the manufacturer.
* **Maintenance** — Servicing intervals, warranty terms and average downtime.
* **Technical assistance** — Loan units, parts availability and software updates.
* **ROI** — Average chair time per patient, additional billable services, retention impact.
* **Financing / leasing** — Manufacturer or distributor leasing options.
* **Workflow integration** — How the unit fits into your existing hygiene appointment, sterilization
  and tray setup.

[Read our detailed comparison of the best dental air polishers →][19]

## What is a dental air polisher?

A dental air polisher is a professional device used in dental prophylaxis and biofilm management. It
delivers a controlled mixture of compressed air, water and a fine cleaning powder onto the tooth
surface. The combined jet removes biofilm, soft deposits and extrinsic stains — including those in
pits, fissures, interproximal areas and around orthodontic appliances or implants.

Air polishing has become a routine part of modern hygiene visits and structured prophylaxis
protocols. Depending on the system and the powder used (sodium bicarbonate, glycine, erythritol,
calcium carbonate and others), it can be used *supragingivally* for stain removal or *subgingivally*
for periodontal and peri-implant maintenance.

Most systems on the market are used by dentists, dental hygienists and prophylaxis assistants in
private practice, multi-chair clinics and dental service organizations.

Established 2004 • 22 Years of Excellence

# Two Decades of Trusted Dental Care

For over 22 Years, Dental Lifeline has been the cornerstone of dental excellence in our community.
Our experienced team of board-certified dentists and specialists brings decades of combined
expertise to every patient interaction.

We combine time-tested techniques with cutting-edge technology to deliver comprehensive dental
solutions that prioritize your oral health and overall well-being.

[Book Appointment][13][View Our Services][14]

## Our Professional Facility

Step inside our modern, fully-equipped clinic designed for your comfort and optimal dental care

## About Us

Meet the dedicated professionals who make Dental Lifeline a trusted name in dental care

20+Years

### A Legacy of Excellence in Dental Care

Since 2004, Dental Lifeline has been at the forefront of dental healthcare, serving thousands of
patients with unwavering commitment to excellence. Our practice has grown from a small clinic to a
comprehensive dental facility, continuously evolving to meet the changing needs of our community.

Our longevity is a testament to our dedication to patient care, clinical excellence, and
professional integrity. We have built lasting relationships with families across generations,
treating grandparents, parents, and children with the same level of expertise and compassion.

Throughout our two decades of service, we have maintained our commitment to continuing education,
ensuring our team stays current with the latest advancements in dental science, technology, and
treatment protocols.

#### Our Mission

To provide exceptional dental care that enhances the health, confidence, and quality of life for
every patient we serve. We believe in treating each patient as a unique individual with personalized
care plans tailored to their specific needs.

#### Our Values
* Clinical Excellence & Evidence-Based Practice
* Compassionate Patient-Centered Care
* Continuous Professional Development
* Integrity & Transparency in All Interactions

### Our Team

[Dr. Abhishek Tayal]

#### Dr. Abhishek Tayal

Director • Prosthodontist & Implantologist

BDS, MDS, Fellow ICOI • 20+ years

Renowned prosthodontist and implantologist. Trained at RGUHS Karnataka; advanced implantology at BIC
Davangere; fellowship from ICOI, USA; surgical training in Lisbon. Former dental school professor,
now leading Dental Lifeline with a focus on prosthetic and implant dentistry, especially geriatric
care.

[Dr. Suruchi Chaudhary]

#### Dr. Suruchi Chaudhary

Principal Dentist • Conservative & Endodontist

BDS, MDS, Member IES • 20+ years

Postgraduate in Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics (Pt. B D Sharma University, Rohtak). Former
professor and academician with deep expertise in complex RCTs and retreatments, preserving damaged
teeth with an esthetic focus. Experienced with pediatric patients and managing failed root canals.

## Comprehensive Dental Services

Our extensive range of services covers all aspects of dental care, from preventive maintenance to
complex restorative procedures

### General & Preventive Dentistry

Comprehensive oral examinations, professional cleanings, fluoride treatments, and sealants. Our
preventive approach helps maintain optimal oral health and prevents dental issues before they
develop.

### Cosmetic Dentistry

Teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, composite bonding, and complete smile makeovers. Transform your
smile with our advanced cosmetic techniques and premium materials.

### Restorative Dentistry

Dental crowns, bridges, fillings, and inlays/onlays. We restore function and aesthetics using
durable, biocompatible materials that blend seamlessly with your natural teeth.

### Oral Surgery & Implants

Dental implant placement, tooth extractions, bone grafting, and oral pathology. Our surgical team
performs procedures with precision and minimal discomfort.

### Endodontics

Root canal therapy and endodontic retreatment. We preserve natural teeth through advanced endodontic
techniques, ensuring long-term oral health.

### Periodontics

Gum disease treatment, scaling and root planing, and periodontal maintenance. We specialize in
maintaining healthy gums and supporting structures.

Our Vision

## Edgbaston Smile Clinic - Your Dental Clinic in Birmingham

Edgbaston Smile Clinic in Birmingham offers a wide range of cosmetic and restorative dental
treatments to refresh, restore and rejuvenate your smile. Our aim is to promote oral health and
achieve great aesthetic and functional results.

Our ethos is to place our clients’ needs at the centre of everything that we do and provide the
highest quality of service.  

Our expert dentists offer the highest quality of dental care, providing all aspects of dentistry
including orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, general dentistry, missing teeth and emergency
dentistry.

We are proud and excited to partner with Ora Dental at their clinic in the Edgbaston Medical Quarter
in Birmingham. Ora Dental is a state-of-the-art purpose built dental centre of excellence. We
combine world class service and amenities that you won't find anywhere else. We have the expertise
and technology to serve all of your dental needs including same-day smile rehabilitations. Ora
Dental is one of the few practices in the world with an on-site dental laboratory so that your
treatment can be completed in one visit.

*Please note, Edgbaston Smile does not admit NHS patients. Only one person is allowed in the clinic
for your appointment. Outdoor seating is provided and we have a range of restaurants/coffee shops
nearby*

Our Vision

## Edgbaston Smile Clinic - Your Dental Clinic in Birmingham

Edgbaston Smile Clinic in Birmingham offers a wide range of cosmetic and restorative dental
treatments to refresh, restore and rejuvenate your smile. Our aim is to promote oral health and
achieve great aesthetic and functional results.

Our ethos is to place our clients’ needs at the centre of everything that we do and provide the
highest quality of service.  

Our expert dentists offer the highest quality of dental care, providing all aspects of dentistry
including orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, general dentistry, missing teeth and emergency
dentistry.

We are proud and excited to partner with Ora Dental at their clinic in the Edgbaston Medical Quarter
in Birmingham. Ora Dental is a state-of-the-art purpose built dental centre of excellence. We
combine world class service and amenities that you won't find anywhere else. We have the expertise
and technology to serve all of your dental needs including same-day smile rehabilitations. Ora
Dental is one of the few practices in the world with an on-site dental laboratory so that your
treatment can be completed in one visit.

*Please note, Edgbaston Smile does not admit NHS patients. Only one person is allowed in the clinic
for your appointment. Outdoor seating is provided and we have a range of restaurants/coffee shops
nearby*

PartialCAD 3.3 Chemnitz introduces a highly automated, guided split denture workflow that simplifies
design and speeds up production. From precise bar tops to enhanced post tools and automatic gingiva
thickness control, this release helps you achieve consistent, high-quality results with ease.

## Browse our exocad webshop

Upgrade your *DentalCAD* license or purchase add-on modules anytime, anywhere from our exocad

solution.

For many dental students, digital dentistry is still limited to a few classroom exercises. For Dr.
János Panyi, his curiosity pushed him to dive into digital long before graduation. In this exoBlog,
we hear how discovering exocad software through the student license helped János hone the skills he
now uses every day in practice.

[Read the interview][77]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

## How to purchase exocad software

exocad’s software solutions are distributed by a global network of trusted partners who also provide
easy-to-access after-sales service like installations, training and technical support. For product
support, offers or more information, please contact one of our partners.

Please note: ChairsideCAD and exoplan are certified as Medical Devices for distribution in selected
countries only. For further details please contact your reseller.

[ramyar daraei profile picture][ramyar daraei profile picture]
[ramyar daraei][81]
4 years ago
I needed two root canals in November and my coworker highly recommended this place. I was treated by
Dr. Afgan and he did an excellent job on both teeth. I am admittedly a difficult patient, so I
especially appreciated how he and the staff patiently answered all my questions about the
procedures. The office is beautiful and spacious, and the staff are professional and very welcoming.
I’ve had no issues since the procedures and easily recommend this practice to anyone seeking quality
dental care.
[Tiffany Henson profile picture][Tiffany Henson profile picture]
[Tiffany Henson][82]
4 years ago
First and foremost Dr. Nader Afgha is outstanding in all aspects, however it wouldn’t be without the
the whole staff. From the front desk to thee assistant. Everyone is always welcoming and warm. Your
needs are priority 100% of the time you walk through the doors. And let’s not get me on the
atmosphere. One of the most relaxing, calming dentistry I every been too. there music playlist is
like relaxing at spa while getting teeth tend to from cleaning to root canal.. I was always
comfortable and calming. The extra ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ go to Dr. Nader, the only dentist that has numb💉my
mouth without it actually hurting or fill like am being stabbed. So if your looking for a actual
real family oriented dentistry to make home for your home. This Team is it. Real review from a real
patient.
[Trisha Reddy profile picture][Trisha Reddy profile picture]
[Trisha Reddy][83]
4 years ago
This place is amazing!
Right off the bat- the office is nice, neat, and very welcoming to walk into. The staff are
extremely kind and open to any questions you have, and the dentists take their time to address each
of your concerns. Left feeling extremely content with the services I received, despite being scared
of dental work. Would 10/10 recommend.
[Mark Wodarski profile picture][Mark Wodarski profile picture]
[Mark Wodarski][84]
4 years ago
I have been a patient here for about 3 months now and have already been through a few big
procedures. The dentist and assistants really made everything so comfortable. They were so nice and
kind about everything and going to the dentist was the last thing I use to want to do but now don’t
mind going because everyone there is beyond nice!! They don’t rush you into making a decision they
give you options and give you time! I would recommend this dentist to everyone!!! And it’s super
clean!!!
[Jasmine Sanchez profile picture][Jasmine Sanchez profile picture]
[Jasmine Sanchez][85]
4 years ago
The whole team here is amazing. The office is clean, my wait was short, and they made sure I
understood every step in my treatment plan. I am terrified of the dentist due to past experiences
but they made me feel at ease. The best dental office I have ever been too. Jaime is amazing with
explaining the cost and pay options. I recommend this dental group.
[Ms. L Lathan profile picture][Ms. L Lathan profile picture]
[Ms. L Lathan][86]
4 years ago
I have been a patient at this dental group for a few years. All the staff members are extremely kind
and helpful. The office is clean and beautiful. The manager will help in any way she can to resolve
any questions or issues. I recently had to undergo major dental work.I was extremely nervous and
worried. Dr Park, Allene and Nastaaja were extremely professional, pleasant and patient. They made
the process easy and comfortable. I’m still in my healing process and their work is looking good
already.
[Relationship goals black love profile picture][Relationship goals black love profile picture]
[Relationship goals black love][87]
4 years ago
Rugiatu Bangura
When I enter this dental office for my first appointment? I just wowed, super clean, fancy and the
customer service is excellent, I had to call my husband right away to switch his dental to Glen
Burnie dental group. When to see the dentist My teeth was checked thoroughly with several x-ray
which I never experienced from my previous dentists. Everyone is polite and have a great sense of
humor. Forever my dentist now
[Laura Davis profile picture][Laura Davis profile picture]
[Laura Davis][88]
4 years ago
I was referred by a friend I trust! His high recommendation did not fall short! It’s a beautiful
clean office. The staff is kind and the experience did not disappoint! I was treated with
gentleness, kindness, and comforting hands. Although I love the dentist and having my teeth cleaned,
I will need to go back for a cavity and will return with no apprehension. Very positive experience
and am happy to have found a new place I can consider my new home dentist.

## Built for Industries Where Every Click Is Expensive

The higher your CPC, the more money you lose to slow follow-up. These industries see the biggest ROI
from instant AI callback.

### Real Estate

Buyers search "homes for sale in [city]" and fill your lead form. By the time they click the next
listing, Lexi is already on the phone scheduling a showing.

### Dental & Medical

Someone Googles "emergency dentist near me" at 11 PM. They fill your LSA form. Lexi calls, confirms
insurance, and books the 8 AM slot before they try the next provider.

### Home Services

A homeowner searches "roof repair" after a storm. Your Google Ads click costs $85. Lexi calls in 30
seconds, books the inspection, and that $85 turns into a $12,000 job.

### Insurance

Quote shoppers click 3-4 ads and fill multiple forms. The agency that calls first writes the policy.
Lexi makes sure that agency is yours - every single time.

### Solar

Solar CPCs run $40-70. The lead fills out a form, then Googles two more installers. Lexi calls while
they are still in research mode and locks down the site visit.

### Legal

Personal injury clicks cost $100+. A potential client fills your form from a hospital waiting room.
Lexi calls immediately, captures case details, and books the consultation before a competing firm
can.

## Google Ads + AI Callback: Your Questions Answered

How does Lexi connect to my Google Ads campaigns?
You paste a webhook URL into your Google Lead Form Extensions - that is it. When someone fills out
your ad form, the data hits our system and Lexi dials within seconds. For landing pages, you can
connect via Zapier, direct API, or native integrations with form builders like Typeform, Jotform,
and Gravity Forms.
I run Google Local Services Ads (LSA). Does this work?
Yes. Google LSA leads are routed to Lexi through the Google LSA API or Zapier. Every lead from your
LSA profile gets an instant callback, which is critical because LSA leads are actively comparing the
top 3 providers in real time.
What does Lexi actually say when she calls?
You write the script. Lexi introduces herself, references the specific service they searched for (so
they know exactly why she is calling), runs through your qualification questions, handles common
objections with answers you approve, and books the appointment. You control every word.
My CPCs are $50-100+. How does this protect my ad spend?
That is the entire point. You already paid Google for that click. Research shows 78% of deals go to
whoever calls first, and 80% of leads go cold after 5 minutes. If you are spending $50-100 per click
and your team takes 4 hours to follow up, most of that budget is wasted. Lexi ensures every click
gets a live conversation within 60 seconds.
Can Lexi warm-transfer to my sales team?
Yes. If a lead is highly qualified or specifically asks for a human, Lexi bridges your sales rep
into the live call with a private briefing - your rep joins already knowing the lead name, what they
searched for, and which questions they answered. Zero hold time for the lead.
How does this affect my Google Ads Quality Score?
Indirectly but meaningfully. Faster lead response means higher conversion rates. Higher conversion
rates mean better conversion tracking data flowing back to Google Ads. Better conversion data means
Google optimizes your bidding more effectively, which can lower your CPC over time and improve ad
rank.
What about leads that come in at 2 AM or on weekends?
Lexi works 24/7/365. A lead who fills your form at 2 AM on a Saturday gets called at 2 AM on a
Saturday. For high-CPC campaigns, after-hours leads are often the highest intent - they are
researching when no one else is available. Those are the clicks you absolutely cannot afford to let
sit until Monday.
How is a voice call better than a chatbot or email drip?
Search-intent leads are actively shopping right now. They filled your form because they want to talk
to someone. A chatbot asks them to type more. An email drip reaches them hours later when they have
already hired your competitor. A live phone call within 60 seconds catches them at peak buying
intent - and voice converts 6x better than text-based follow-up.

already hired your competitor. A live phone call within 60 seconds catches them at peak buying

## Air Polishing: A Modern Approach to Dental Cleaning

As we continuously seek ways to enhance patient care and embrace innovative techniques, it's crucial
to understand why air polishing, particularly with advancements like erythritol + CHX powder, is
becoming the preferred choice over traditional dental cleaning methods.

***Our goals as dental professionals in an active maintenance check up and clean appointment should
be to:***

[A checklist]

Assess the patient’s oral hygiene and periodontal health

[A presenter pointing to a display in front of an audience]

Educate and improve the patient’s oral hygiene

[An X within a circle]

Remove biofilm and calculus

[Silhouette of two people high fiving]

Create an environment that empowers patients to maintain oral health

We all know mature biofilm is the trigger for periodontal disease as well as decay. And yet calculus
still holds the limelight in traditional cleans. Air polishing assisted by disclosing agents puts
biofilm as the focus of our appointment - not just its removal, but getting patients themselves to
see and understand biofilm removal so they can improve their daily habits. Modern dentistry aims to
shift away from the old fashioned, paternal “doctors prescribe treatment to patients” mentality, and
instead move towards a “we are here to assist you in controlling your disease risk” mindset. 

We need to shift our focus to targeted cleaning rather than using ultrasonic scalers on every
surface, which creates microroughness.

### Benefits of Air Polishing

Stain Removal

[Black background with white paint splatter in the center and smaller splatters nearby.]

• Far more effective and efficient at removing stains and biofilm, especially in grooves, under
bridges and around orthodontic brackets. 

Low Abrasion

[Black arrow pointing downward.]

• The small particle size and softness gives it a very low abrasion level. It does not damage
dentine - unlike ultrasonic scaler tips. The recommended way to clean implants

Shorter Appointments

[Icon of a stopwatch showing 12:00.]

• Air polishing is a faster method to remove the soft deposits and staining first, before using more
aggressive scaling to remove calculus

Less Operator Fatigue

[Icon of a battery with a low charge level.]
[ Free Trial Available ][39]

• There is much less strain on the operator wrist  as there is no need to apply pressure on dozens
of angled surfaces like there is with a rubber polishing cup

### Benefits of Erythritol Powder 

Inhibits Harmful Bacteria

[No parking sign]

Safe for the Environment

[Black and white graphic of a plant with two leaves]

Safe for Pipes

[White U-shaped pipe with two sections on a black background.]

Erythritol + CHX powder is not only the least abrasive powder on the market at a particle size of
only 14 microns, but it also has positive influence on the bacteria links to periodontal disease and
decay.

Erythritol is a natural, non-caloric sweetener that is anticariogenic. Cariogenic bacteria such as
Streptococcus mutans cannot metabolise erythrotol and do not survive well in its presence. The
addition of 0.3% chlorhexidine furthers erythritol’s inhibitory effects on biofilm due to its
anti-adherence and antimicrobial properties.

It dissolves completely in water so is safe for the environment and your pipes!

  ## they’ve ever experienced. They love the warm water, the gentle powder and the delicate yet
  ## effective ultrasonic. My DA is thrilled with the time efficient set up/shut down and
  ## maintenance of the PT-B machine

***Our goals as dental professionals in an active maintenance check up and clean appointment should
be to:***

[A checklist]

Assess the patient’s oral hygiene and periodontal health

[A presenter pointing to a display in front of an audience]

Educate and improve the patient’s oral hygiene

[An X within a circle]

Remove biofilm and calculus

[Silhouette of two people high fiving]

Create an environment that empowers patients to maintain oral health

We all know mature biofilm is the trigger for periodontal disease as well as decay. And yet calculus
still holds the limelight in traditional cleans. Air polishing assisted by disclosing agents puts
biofilm as the focus of our appointment - not just its removal, but getting patients themselves to
see and understand biofilm removal so they can improve their daily habits. Modern dentistry aims to
shift away from the old fashioned, paternal “doctors prescribe treatment to patients” mentality, and
instead move towards a “we are here to assist you in controlling your disease risk” mindset. 

We need to shift our focus to targeted cleaning rather than using ultrasonic scalers on every
surface, which creates microroughness.

### Benefits of Air Polishing

Stain Removal

[Black background with white paint splatter in the center and smaller splatters nearby.]

• Far more effective and efficient at removing stains and biofilm, especially in grooves, under
bridges and around orthodontic brackets. 

Low Abrasion

[Black arrow pointing downward.]

• The small particle size and softness gives it a very low abrasion level. It does not damage
dentine - unlike ultrasonic scaler tips. The recommended way to clean implants

Shorter Appointments

[Icon of a stopwatch showing 12:00.]

• Air polishing is a faster method to remove the soft deposits and staining first, before using more
aggressive scaling to remove calculus

Less Operator Fatigue

[Icon of a battery with a low charge level.]
[ Free Trial Available ][39]

• There is much less strain on the operator wrist  as there is no need to apply pressure on dozens
of angled surfaces like there is with a rubber polishing cup

### Benefits of Erythritol Powder 

Inhibits Harmful Bacteria

[No parking sign]

Safe for the Environment

[Black and white graphic of a plant with two leaves]

Safe for Pipes

[White U-shaped pipe with two sections on a black background.]

Erythritol + CHX powder is not only the least abrasive powder on the market at a particle size of
only 14 microns, but it also has positive influence on the bacteria links to periodontal disease and
decay.

Erythritol is a natural, non-caloric sweetener that is anticariogenic. Cariogenic bacteria such as
Streptococcus mutans cannot metabolise erythrotol and do not survive well in its presence. The
addition of 0.3% chlorhexidine furthers erythritol’s inhibitory effects on biofilm due to its
anti-adherence and antimicrobial properties.

It dissolves completely in water so is safe for the environment and your pipes!

## Services

**We don't just make them. We keep them performing.**

Exceptional instruments are just the beginning. From sharpening to chairside support, and the
industry's longest-running instrument recycling program, we're here for you.
[Evercare Service and Repairs logo]

EverCare

Instrument Sharpening Service

Expert factory-precision sharpening with an average 30 years of artisan experience.
Subscription-based plans with free shipping and 3.5-day turnaround.
[Learn More][129]
[GreenLight by HuFriedyGroup logo]

GreenLight

Compliance Center

Your single online portal for infection prevention compliance. Self-assess protocols, access OSHA
training, and get free expert consultations for your practice.
[Learn More][130]
[Envirodent instrument recycling logo]

Environdent

Instrument Recycling Program

The dental industry's longest-running instrument recycling program, since 1995. Recycle 12
instruments of any brand and receive a HuFriedyGroup instrument free.
[Learn More][131]
[Surgical HuCare]

Surgical HuCare

HuCare Surgical provides complimentary lifetime servicing for eligible HuFriedyGroup surgical
instruments, helping clinicians protect their investment and maintain peak instrument performance.
[Learn More][132]
[Ortho HuCare]

Ortho HuCare

HuCare Ortho provides complimentary lifetime servicing for eligible HuFriedyGroup orthodontic
instruments, helping practices protect their investment and maintain optimal instrument performance.
[Learn More][133]

## Education

**You trained on our instruments. Keep learning with us.**

Most clinicians learned on our instruments. That's just where the relationship starts. From CE
webinars to our 45,000-member Friends of Hu-Friedy community and dedicated residency programs, we've
made it our business to help you with yours.
[Keep growing with us][134]
[Smiling dental student]

## Who We're For

DSOs & Group Practices

What works in one room has to work in all of them. We help DSOs standardize clinical protocols,
instrument sets, and reprocessing workflows across every site, every staff, every shift.

Practice Owners

You built your practice on standards. We help protect them. Our instruments and solutions hold up to
a full schedule and give your team something they can count on.

Clinicians & Hygienists

You know the difference between an instrument that performs and one that just exists. We make sure
you never have to settle for the latter, in year two or twenty.

Dental Students & Educators

You're learning on HuFriedyGroup because that's what the best programs use. When you graduate and
you're building your own tray, you'll remember what good feels like.
[Dentist treating a patient in dental chair]

## Why HuFriedyGroup

Behind Every Instrument
Every tool we make is developed alongside the clinicians who use it. People who know what sharpness,
ergonomics, and durability feel like across a full schedule.
Behind Every Procedure
Our lineup spans preventive, surgical, and implantology care, so every step connects seamlessly to
the next, exactly the way it should. One chair or a hundred. The ecosystem works the same.
Behind Every Steady Hand
Muscle memory is real. When your instruments perform consistently, your hands stop compensating and
start doing their best work. Consistent tools. Consistent care. Every patient. Every appointment.
Behind Every Practice
DSOs, group practices, solo offices. Real-world conditions. Real volume. Real pressure. We've proven
we hold up in all of it. At every scale, the standard stays the same.
Behind Every Great Outcome
A whole-practice ecosystem. Every tool, every step, every procedure working toward one trusted,
predictable result. From preventive through surgical to implantology.
[Dental clinicians working overhead view]
[ [Hu-Friedy Group] ][135]

The Best in Practice • Since 1908

We make instruments dental professionals trust for life — and we've been doing it, from one Chicago
workshop, for 118 years.

Real-time air quality data from over 80,000 monitoring sensors worldwide.

## **Klaus Hammes**

Visionary and pioneer in clean air

April 7, 1939 - April 30, 2026

With the passing of Klaus Hammes, IQAir has lost its visionary founder, who, from the 1960s through
the 1990s, improved air quality for people around the world through the innovative use of air filter
technology in buildings and vehicles. Klaus Hammes was a pioneer of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ),
Cleantech and HealthTech industries and continues to inspire the work of IQAir to this day.

## Clean air solutions. Proven protection.

Trusted by hospitals, schools, and families worldwide, IQAir air purifiers remove ultrafine
particles down to 0.003 microns — the smallest particles that impact your health the most.
Experience cleaner, healthier air in every room.

just [**walk in**][89].

## [Trehalose Air-Polishing Powder: What the 2025 Meta-Analysis Found][27]

A 2025 network meta-analysis pooling nine randomized controlled trials and 462 patients ranked
erythritol, trehalose, and glycine as subgingival air-polishing powders. No statistically
significant pairwise differences on probing depth, attachment, or bleeding — but the SUCRA scores
tell a more nuanced story. Verbatim numbers, primary source (Zi-le et al., *Frontiers in
Physiology*, DOI 10.3389/fphys.2025.1593204), and where trehalose fits in 2026 practice.

Preventio Hub | May 16, 2026 | 8 min read
[Air polishing for peri-implantitis: new 2026 BMC Oral Health RCT]
Science New

### [Air Polishing for Peri-Implantitis in Severe Periodontitis: What the 2026 BMC RCT Found][28]

Dai et al. (BMC Oral Health 26:192, DOI 10.1186/s12903-026-07721-z) randomized 40 stage III/IV
periodontitis patients with peri-implantitis to submarginal erythritol air-polishing vs
ultrasonic+manual debridement. PPD at 3 months: no significant difference. Soft-tissue inflammation
(mSBI) significantly lower in the air-polishing arm. Keratinized mucosa width ≥ 2 mm raised odds of
PPD ≤ 5 mm by ~9.8×.

May 25, 2026 9 min read
[Air polishing and aerosol contamination: 2025 evidence]
Science

### [Air Polishing and Aerosol Contamination: What the 2025 Evidence Shows][29]

A 2025 observational study by Mensi et al. (Int J Dent Hyg, DOI 10.1111/idh.12881) found air
polishing did not raise airborne bacterial counts above the empty-clinic baseline of 1.45 CFU/L. The
highest contamination came from turbine cavity prep with low-volume evacuation, at 7.38 CFU/L.
Evacuation choice is the variable that matters.

publicly disclosed and what isn't.

## Proceed.Fit: Your Gateway to Affordable Healthcare and Hospitalization Services

**At Proceed.Fit**, we are dedicated to making **affordable healthcare** accessible to everyone. As
a trusted healthcare technology platform, we ensure that people from all backgrounds can receive
high-quality medical care at **competitive rates**.

Our innovative platform connects users to top healthcare providers, offering cost-effective
**treatment options** without compromising quality. We understand the financial strain that comes
with medical care, which is why we prioritize **transparent pricing** and provide upfront cost
estimates for a wide range of treatments and procedures.

By partnering with leading hospitals, **fitness experts**, nutritionists, ambulance services,
diagnostic labs, and pharmacies, we secure **exclusive discounts** and offers for our users. Our
mission is to make healthcare more affordable and accessible, ensuring you receive the care you need
at a price that fits your budget.

Here at Truist Dental, Dr. Meenal Thirtha and our compassionate team are proud to serve the Irving,
TX community with exceptional dental care. We offer comprehensive family, cosmetic, and restorative
dentistry designed to support your lifelong oral health and help you smile with confidence.

Our approach to dentistry is personalized and patient-centered. Whether you need preventive dental
care for the whole family or advanced cosmetic treatments, we tailor each visit to your unique
needs. From children to seniors, we are here to ensure every member of your family feels comfortable
and cared for in our modern dental office.

help you.

Here at Truist Dental, Dr. Meenal Thirtha and our compassionate team are proud to serve the Irving,
TX community with exceptional dental care. We offer comprehensive family, cosmetic, and restorative
dentistry designed to support your lifelong oral health and help you smile with confidence.

Our approach to dentistry is personalized and patient-centered. Whether you need preventive dental
care for the whole family or advanced cosmetic treatments, we tailor each visit to your unique
needs. From children to seniors, we are here to ensure every member of your family feels comfortable
and cared for in our modern dental office.

## Root Canal Treatment

Root Canal Treatment (RCT) is a procedure used to treat infected or damaged tooth pulp, relieving
pain and saving the tooth. Essential products used in RCT include a Rubber Dam for isolation, an
Endomotor and Files for canal preparation, and an Apex Locator for precise working length
determination. GP (Gutta-Percha) and Paper Points help in canal filling and drying, while X-ray RVG
ensures accuracy. Finally, Filling Material restores the tooth’s structure, ensuring
long-term success.

## Root Canal Treatment

Root Canal Treatment (RCT) is a procedure used to treat infected or damaged tooth pulp, relieving
pain and saving the tooth. Essential products used in RCT include a Rubber Dam for isolation, an
Endomotor and Files for canal preparation, and an Apex Locator for precise working length
determination. GP (Gutta-Percha) and Paper Points help in canal filling and drying, while X-ray RVG
ensures accuracy. Finally, Filling Material restores the tooth’s structure, ensuring
long-term success.
